pull.title: fuzz: Fix assertion in `txorphan`
pull.body: `EraseTx()` calls `LimitOrphans()`, which may evict announcements from a peer that didn't announce the erased transaction, causing that peer's usage to decrease. Relax the assertion in the `EraseTx()` branch that claimed usage of a non-announcer peer should be unchanged. Also, add assertions for the other cases.

events.message:
fuzz: Fix assertion in txorphan

EraseTx calls LimitOrphans, which may evict announcements from a peer
that didn't announce the erased transaction, causing that peer's usage
to decrease. Relax the assertion in the EraseTx branch that claimed
usage of a non-announcer peer is unchanged. Also, add assertions for
the other cases.
